test: real replay, sensor evidence, pinned questions and keyboard navigation
observed_failure: The finite 10x replay was COMPLETED at source +365s. The manual handoff journey later attempted to step that terminal replay and timed out because the Step control was correctly disabled.
classification: Manual browser journey raced the end of accelerated playback, not an accepted agent report or a new inference-performance result.
correction: Use 5x for the manual review journey and explicitly require server-confirmed PAUSED state before continuing. Dedicated accelerated-inspector tests retain their original speed. No timeout or inference retry was increased.

subsequent_cohort.test: 1x replay delivers a clear warning independently of the pinned investigation
subsequent_cohort.observed_failure: After browser offline emulation, the paused replay retained a possible-leak warning rather than reporting monitoring unavailable. EventSource disconnection alone did not reliably reflect the known browser-offline state.
subsequent_cohort.correction: Warning and source-clock freshness now also require navigator.onLine, independently of EventSource callbacks. The original disconnect assertion and its timeout are unchanged.
